name: Web Serial
plain: Lets a site open a serial port the person picks and exchange bytes with it.
meaning: Gives a page direct read and write to microcontrollers, 3D printers, GPS modules and Bluetooth serial adapters. Port identity (USB vendor and product id) can be read once granted.

access.prompt_ui: Chooser of available ports; filtered by usbVendorId and usbProductId when supplied
steps: Read through port.readable.getReader() and write through port.writable

samsung.note: Serial ports are only available if they're provided by Bluetooth RFCOMM serial port emulation.

fields.name: baudRate
fields.range: required; commonly 9600 to 115200, up to several Mbaud

limits.headline: Can open one serial port you pick and exchange data with it
limits.user_action: You tap Connect device and pick a port in the chooser.
can: Show the available ports, filtered by device type if the site asks
Open the one port you pick
Send and get data with that device, such as a 3D printer or a board
cannot: Open a port you did not pick
Open any port without the chooser
Work in Safari, including on iPhone
Keep access after you remove the permission or unplug the device
limits.differs: Chrome and Edge support it. Safari and iPhone do not. Samsung Internet only partly.

story.what_it_is: A site can connect to a device on a serial port that you pick.

marketing.name: Web Serial
marketing.pitch: Chrome's docs say Web Serial lets a page read and write to serial devices like microcontrollers and 3D printers.

story.for_you: A picker lists plugged in devices. You pick one, and the page can send and read data from it, like a 3D printer or a circuit board.
story.for_makers: Makers can set up and update hardware from a web page, with no driver or app. It is a big win for maker tools and factory test jigs.

use_cases.example: A web page flashes new code onto an Arduino or ESP32 board.
A coding class programs a robot from a browser tab.
A 3D printer dashboard sends commands from the page.
A factory tool tests devices and records the results.
A page sets up a sensor board for home use.
A malicious page could trick someone into picking a device that holds secrets.

technical_bounds: Needs picker selection each origin; no silent enumeration
Cannot access ports the OS reserves (some system consoles)
Bluetooth serial limited to RFCOMM profile devices
Safari and iOS have no implementation

abuse: Writing hostile firmware to a connected board

history.change: Web Serial ships on desktop Chromium
Android support for serial ports and USB or Bluetooth devices emulating serial
Firefox adds Web Serial per BCD
